# Shopify stores Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/shopify-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/shopify-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product data from Shopify storefronts, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Shopify Stores for Products, Prices, and Variants](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-shopify-stores)
- **Code:** [`shopify.py`](shopify.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Storefront preflight](results/preflight.json) · [Catalog products.json](results/catalog.json) · [Collection products](results/collection.json) · [Product pages](results/product_pages.json) · [Sitemap product urls](results/product_urls.json)

## What it scrapes

- Shopify storefront preflight, which classifies the `/products.json` response of a store
- Shopify catalog pages from `/products.json`, with products, prices and nested variants
- Shopify collection products from `/collections/<handle>/products.json`
- Shopify product pages through their JSON-LD `Product` and `ProductGroup` data
- Shopify product URLs from the store sitemap index

## Functions

- `scrape_catalog(store_url, max_pages=2, limit=CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE, collection=None)` → `List[ShopifyProduct]`: scrape products from a Shopify storefront products.json route
- `scrape_collection(store_url, collection, max_pages=2, limit=CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE)` → `List[ShopifyProduct]`: scrape products of a single Shopify collection, keeping the merchandising context
- `scrape_product_pages(urls)` → `List[ShopifyProductPage]`: scrape Shopify product pages, the fallback when the catalog JSON route is unusable
- `scrape_product_urls(store_url, max_sitemaps=1)` → `List[str]`: discover product URLs from the Shopify sitemap index

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import shopify


async def main():
    catalog = await shopify.scrape_catalog(store_url="https://www.allbirds.com", max_pages=2, limit=20)
    collection = await shopify.scrape_collection(
        store_url="https://www.deathwishcoffee.com",
        collection="coffee",
        max_pages=1,
        limit=20,
    )
    product_pages = await shopify.scrape_product_pages(
        urls=[
            "https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-strider-medium-grey",
            "https://www.deathwishcoffee.com/products/vanilla-10oz",
        ],
    )
    product_urls = await shopify.scrape_product_urls(store_url="https://www.allbirds.com")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`ShopifyVariant`**: `variant_id`, `title?`, `sku?`, `options`, `price?`, `compare_at_price?`, `available?`
- **`ShopifyProduct`**: `product_id`, `handle`, `url`, `title?`, `vendor?`, `product_type?`, `description?`, `tags`, `options`, `images`, `variants`, `price_min?`, `price_max?`, `published_at?`, `updated_at?`
- **`ShopifyPreflight`**: `store_url`, `catalog_url`, `status_code`, `content_type?`, `outcome`, `product_count?`, `is_shopify_catalog`
- **`ShopifyOffer`**: `sku?`, `title?`, `price?`, `currency?`, `availability?`, `url?`
- **`ShopifyProductPage`**: `url`, `schema_type?`, `product_id?`, `name?`, `brand?`, `sku?`, `description?`, `images`, `price?`, `currency?`, `availability?`, `offers`, `variant_urls`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`shopify.py`](shopify.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Notes

Every route is store dependent, so run the preflight before assuming a store serves catalog JSON.

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/shopify-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_preflight_scraping`, `test_catalog_scraping`, `test_collection_scraping`, `test_product_page_scraping`, `test_product_urls_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
